**Subhasish Mukherjee.** "Exact dimensionality of stationary measures for
nonuniformly conformally contracting random diffeomorphisms." Preprint, 2026.

[arXiv:2609.10538](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.10538) ·
[PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.10538)

## Abstract

We prove exact dimensionality of ergodic stationary measures for random $C^1$
diffeomorphisms in the single negative Lyapunov scale setting. Let $\nu$ be a
Borel probability measure on $\operatorname{Diff}^1(M)$ satisfying a logarithmic
$C^1$ moment condition, and let $\mu$ be a $\nu$-stationary ergodic probability
measure. If $\lambda_{\mathrm{top}} = \lambda_{\mathrm{bot}} = \lambda < 0$,
then $\mu$ is exact dimensional and
$\dim(\mu) = h_\mu^{\mathrm{F}}(\nu)/(-\lambda)$. No discreteness assumption is
imposed on the driving measure.
